Require expected arm C, identical stage/workload/settings/model/runtime/source manifest before candidate inference. Missing matched timing case must fail rather than silently skip comparison.
Call capacity_check after histories and immediately before status pass. History loop currently performs no capacity checks; final machine_state merely records changed power/swap/RSS.
